title: At the moment Vol.1 (Kyoto underground rock/noise night)
title_ja: “At the moment Vol.1”
lineup: Music Start Against Young Assault Again, BLONDnewHALF, ZNS, 数えきれない, peach Fuzz
description: Five-band holiday-afternoon bill of Kansai DIY rock, noise-pop and psych acts at the city's key alternative room. Doors 17:30. Adv 2500 / door 3000 plus 700 yen drink.
underground_reason: Local DIY bands in an artist-run 120-cap room; no mainstream booking

title: FOuR DANCERS vol.368 - dance performance night
title_ja: FOuR DANCERS vol.368～dance performance night～
lineup: Bridget Scott＋ryotaro (sound), Ami Skånberg+ Kiku Day, 辻野恵子, 伊藤まき
description: Four short contemporary/improv dance sets, incl. Bridget Scott with ryotaro on sound and Ami Skanberg with Kiku Day. Doors 19:00. Adv 2300, door 2600, dancers 1700, +700 drink.
underground_reason: Artist-run monthly dance night (360+ editions) with a reduced dancer ticket; mixes local and visiting improvisers

title: Takoashi Earphones x Seiichi Yamamoto
title_ja: タコ足イヤホンズ × 山本精一
lineup: タコ足イヤホンズ (細井徳太郎, 津上研太, 高橋佑成, 阿部真武, 椿三期), 山本精一
description: Tokyo free-jazz/rock quintet led by guitarist Tokutaro Hosoi meets Boredoms/Rovo guitarist Seiichi Yamamoto, who takes each member into his set. Doors 19:00. Adv 3500, door 4000, U25 2000, +700 drink.
underground_reason: Improvising jazz-rock players in a small artist-run room; Yamamoto is a Kansai underground elder

title: Dance to Gohan vol.9: Amijiro & junjun SCIENCE short dance works
title_ja: アミジロウ & じゅんじゅんSCIENCE ダンス小作品集「ダンスとごはん vol.9」
lineup: じゅんじゅんSCIENCE (髙橋淳, 久井麻世), 瀧口翔, ネコ ザ ゴースト, 島田雄一, アミジロウ
description: Omnibus of ~10-min dance pieces by Tokyo company junjun SCIENCE and Kyoto guests, each followed by the makers talking about it (in Japanese). Doors 19:00. 2800 adv / 3300 door incl. 1 drink.
underground_reason: Artist-organised small-works showing in an artist-run bar-theatre; talk-back format built for meeting the makers

title: Holobiont
title_ja: “Holobiont”
lineup: C=3, Eri Nagami, 白目, 高山燦基
description: Four-act experimental/electronic night with a small zine and book stall (Yokozuna Bunko). Doors 18:30. Adv 3000, door 3500, +700 drink. Lineup read from the venue list page; detail page not opened.
underground_reason: Small experimental bill plus zine stall in an artist-run room

title: Seiichi Yamamoto & THE PLAYGROUND with Kota Yamauchi: vague believers on Holy Night
title_ja: 山本精一 & THE PLAYGROUND with 山内弘太 〜vague believers on Holy Night〜
lineup: 山本精一 (vo,g), 須原敬三 (b), senoo ricky (ds), 山内弘太 (g)
description: Christmas-night set by Seiichi Yamamoto's rock trio with Kyoto guitarist Kota Yamauchi; the Kansai underground's house band on a holiday. Doors 19:00. Adv 3500, door 4000, +700 drink. No infants.
underground_reason: Veteran underground players, small room, no commercial booking

title: Meirin Workshop: Gesu◎ 'Workshop for (really) betting on the future'
title_ja: 明倫ワークショップ Gesu◎「未来を／に（本当に）賭けるワークショップ」
lineup: Gesu◎
description: Free 3-hour workshop by political-performance collective Gesu◎: pick a future you want (or not), build an action, perform it with what is in the room. Feeds their Nov show T1NA. 18+, 10 places.
underground_reason: Young artist collective testing dialogue-based performance in the city centre's free studios; institution hosts, artists run it

title: Meirin Workshop: 'My hands / your hands' body-memory workshop and demonstration (Gekiken)
title_ja: 明倫ワークショップ 劇研「『わたしの手／あなたの手』ワークショップ＆デモンストレーション」
lineup: 細見佳代 (NPO 劇研 / 'My Hands' project)
description: Free 2-hour physical workshop on the memory held in hands and gestures, led by director Kayo Hosomi, then a work-in-progress demo of her piece My Hands. 18+, 20 places, movable clothes.
underground_reason: Public arts centre hosting an artist-led devising process; include as institution with experimental programme

title: Gesu◎: T1NA (new work)
title_ja: Gesu◎ 2026年新作公演『T1NA』
lineup: Gesu◎
description: New dialogue/performance piece on 'betting' by collective Gesu◎, announced on the Kyoto Art Center workshop page. Times, prices and booking not yet found; check askyoto.or.jp/e9 before going.
underground_reason: Young collective in an independent crowdfunded black box

title: Kana Sano & Yusuke Nagashima: Mitasu hoko e mukau (Toward the direction that fills)
title_ja: 佐野加奈・長島裕輔『満たす方向へむかう』
lineup: 佐野加奈, 長島裕輔
description: Duet by two ex-ballet dancers (NBA Ballet / K-Ballet) now making contemporary work: everyday acts inside unreal dance. Sat 12 Dec 18:00, Sun 13 Dec 14:00. Adv 4000, door 4500, unreserved seating.
underground_reason: Independent self-produced dance in a 100-seat artist-run studio theatre

title: Dance Bridge 2026: Mademoiselle Cinema 'Okuni Monogatari'
title_ja: ダンスブリッジ2026 マドモアゼル・シネマ『阿国物語』
lineup: マドモアゼル・シネマ (竹之下たまみ, 蓮子奈津美, 秋元麻友子, 須川萌, 工藤えは, 大堂智子, 齊藤奈彩), 笠井瑞丈, 望月崇博, 石渕聡, 栗原モナコ
description: Resident company, choreographed by founder Naoko Ito, chases the foot-rhythms of kabuki founder Okuni with guest Mitsutake Kasai and chindon brass. 19 Dec 15:00/19:00, 20 Dec 14:00. Adv 4000.
underground_reason: 35-year independent dance house's own company; small room, cross-genre guests

title: Naoko Ito: Dance Basic - exploration class (open class)
title_ja: 伊藤直子 ダンスベーシック・探求クラス
lineup: 伊藤直子
description: Evening open class by Mademoiselle Cinema's choreographer: breath-led core, floor, centre, combinations toward your own physicality. Some experience needed. 2500 yen. Weekdays only, holidays off.
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Naoko Ito: Dance Basic - beginner class (open class)
title_ja: 伊藤直子 ダンスベーシック・初級クラス
lineup: 伊藤直子
description: Daytime beginner-friendly open class: floor work lying down, standing positions, short combinations. Complete beginners welcome. 2500 yen. No class on holidays (3 Nov).
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Ryohei Kondo: 'Flashes of movement' open class
title_ja: 近藤良平 ダンスクラス「動きのひらめき」
lineup: 近藤良平
description: Condors founder Ryohei Kondo's playful class for any level: find the moment the body moves you rather than build technique. Also Tue 19:30-21:00. 2500 yen.
underground_reason: Taught by a major figure of Japanese contemporary dance in a small independent studio; built for non-dancers and dancers alike

title: Taiju Matsumoto: Release Technique (open class)
title_ja: 松本大樹 ダンスクラス「リリース・テクニック」
lineup: 松本大樹
description: Laban/Limon-trained Taiju Matsumoto's release class: swing with gravity, travel on tilted weight, use only the force needed. Beginner version Mon 17:55-19:25. 2500 yen.
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Kaho Kogure: Movement Research (open class)
title_ja: 小暮香帆 ダンスクラス「ムーブメントリサーチ」
lineup: 小暮香帆
description: Morning research class with dancer-choreographer Kaho Kogure: listen to the body, then move through structure, image and rules. Any level; good for makers seeking creation hints. 2500 yen.
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Asami Ida: 'Waking the body from the cell' (Ilan Lev-based open class)
title_ja: 井田亜彩実 細胞から目覚める身体
lineup: 井田亜彩実
description: Israeli Ilan Lev method as the base: release effort, circulate energy from inside, then research, improvisation, pairing. Ida danced in Israel 2014-19; any level. 2500 yen.
underground_reason: Independent studio; rare Israel-lineage somatic class in Tokyo, relevant to a Hebrew-speaking client

title: Takkun Ikegami: Contemporary Contact Technique (open class)
title_ja: 池上たっくん コンテンポラリー コンタクトテクニッククラス
lineup: 池上たっくん
description: Basic training then contact as technique: touch, shared weight, dancing with a partner. Oct 22 & 29 are substitute classes (Onishi/Murai 3-day showing); regular class resumes 5 Nov. 2500 yen.
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Thursday-morning Dance Technique Basics: Release & Flow (Ota), then Technique to Sequence (Hirata) from 3 Dec
title_ja: 2026年度 木曜午前クラス 平田友子監修『ダンステクニック基礎クラス』
lineup: 太田ゆかり (22 Oct-26 Nov), 平田友子 (3 Dec-25 Mar)
description: Curated Thursday course of contemporary fundamentals: Ota's floor release & flow block 22 Oct-26 Nov (6 sessions), then Hirata's ballet-mechanics block from 3 Dec. Single sessions OK, 2500 yen.
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Jun Morii: Contemporary Dance Open Class - floorwork x flow x dynamics
title_ja: 森井淳 コンテンポラリーダンス オープンクラス
lineup: 森井淳
description: Twice-monthly morning class from floor to standing with contact elements, by Laban-trained Jun Morii (Jalet/Cherkaoui productions). No experience needed. 2500 yen. Holidays off (23 Nov).
underground_reason: Independent dance house's open drop-in class taught by a working choreographer; single tickets, no membership

title: Jon Collin (UK/SE), Rob Noyes & Takashi Masubuchi, Lost Wax
lineup: Jon Collin (UK/SE), Rob Noyes & Takashi Masubuchi, Lost Wax
description: Touring guitarist Jon Collin with Rob Noyes and local improviser Takashi Masubuchi in an artist-run basement. Adv 3000 / door 3500. Organiser listing on Tokyo Gig Guide; venue site not opened.
underground_reason: Artist-run alternative space since 2006, tiny room, improv bill

title: Shih-Yang Lee (Taiwan), Shoji Hano, Cal Lyall, Daysuke Takaoka, Miki Naoe
lineup: Shih-Yang Lee (piano, from Taiwan), Shoji Hano (drums), Cal Lyall (guitar), Daysuke Takaoka (tuba), Miki Naoe (radio)
description: Taiwanese pianist Shih-Yang Lee with veteran free drummer Shoji Hano, Cal Lyall, tuba and a radio player: free improvisation in an artist-run basement. 2500 yen. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Artist-run space, free-improv quintet with visiting player

title: Leo Okagawa (electronics) solo
lineup: Leo Okagawa
description: Solo electronics set by Leo Okagawa (organiser of the Clara de Asis nights at Ftarri in Nov). Sliding donation 1000-3000 yen. Tokyo Gig Guide listing; venue page not opened.
underground_reason: Donation-based tiny Meguro bar hosting electroacoustic solos

title: Jun Numata, Toshimaru Nakamura
lineup: Jun Numata, Toshimaru Nakamura
description: Guitarist Jun Numata with no-input mixing board pioneer Toshimaru Nakamura in a small Iriya room. Adv 2300 / door 2500. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Small room, two core Tokyo improvisers

title: Mamoru Narita (Sounddance), Nira (guitar) x Renka (dance), Yasukichi (butoh)
lineup: Mamoru Narita (Sounddance), Nira (Guitar) x Renka (Dance), Yasukichi (Butoh)
description: Sound-and-body night in a Koenji basement: Narita's 'sounddance', a guitar-with-dancer duo and a butoh solo. 2500 + 1 drink. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Koenji DIY room with nightly experimental bills; this one crosses into dance and butoh

title: T. Mikawa, Masahiro Tobita, mito
lineup: 美川俊治 (T.Mikawa), 飛田雅弘 (Masahiro Tobita), ミト (mito)
description: Harsh-noise elder Toshiji Mikawa (Incapacitants) plus Tobita and mito in a Sendagi bar. Pay-what-you-want music charge plus 500 yen bar charge and a drink. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Bar-sized noise show, pay what you want; the Tokyo noise scene's living room

title: Vakvak Samandal (Ken Matsutani, SACHIKO), Kyohansya (isshee, Keiko Higuchi)
lineup: Vakvak Samandal (Ken Matsutani, SACHIKO), Kyohansya (isshee, Keiko Higuchi)
description: Two duos: Marble Sheep's Ken Matsutani with SACHIKO, and the bar's owner isshee with vocalist Keiko Higuchi. Donation plus 500 yen bar charge. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Owner-run bar sets, donation entry

title: Sex Magick Wizards [Norway]
lineup: Sex Magick Wizards
description: Norwegian free-jazz/psych quartet on Japan tour at a small Higashi-Kitazawa room. 3000 yen. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Small independent room booking touring European free-jazz

title: Hideo Ikegami, Philip Gayle, Kazushige Kinoshita
lineup: 池上秀夫 (Hideo Ikegami), Philip Gayle, 木下和重 (Kazushige Kinoshita)
description: Bassist Hideo Ikegami, guitarist Philip Gayle and violinist Kazushige Kinoshita: acoustic free improvisation. 3000 yen. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Small independent room, acoustic improv trio

lineup: Hosoo and Taeyoon Kim (KR), The Lenticularz, Jan Urila Sas, MMORITA, Seibutsu, Sunagimo
description: Six-act electronic/noise night in an Otsuka basement bar with a Korean guest duo. 2000 + 1 drink. Secondary listing only.
underground_reason: Basement bar, DIY electronic bill

title: Paolo Gaiba Riva, Kazehito Seki, Stefan Voglsinger (Vienna), Toshimaru Nakamura, Cal Lyall, DJ MEMAI
lineup: Paolo Gàiba Riva, Kazehito Seki, Stefan Voglsinger, Toshimaru Nakamura, Cal Lyall, DJ MEMAI
description: Vienna's Stefan Voglsinger with Toshimaru Nakamura, Kazehito Seki and Cal Lyall: improvised electronics in a basement bar. 2500 + 1 drink. Voglsinger also plays Oriental Force 12 Nov.
